svg.title: NET-02 — Wildcard host setup with optional password
svg.desc: 850 by 700 logical canvas with fixed banner and endpoint fields. Both setup panels/list bodies extend 44 logical px downward to expose ten complete rows while headings and first rows stay fixed. Count and conditional feedback move down by 44. Bottom-left logical action bounds are Start session (117,38,300,32) and Back (433,38,300,32), translated exactly to this SVG's canvas origin (25,20). Other diagram positions remain approximate; the NET-02 geometry table owns exact list bounds. Valid idle setup has no listing/direct-play help or readiness text. Port keeps initial focus; popup/progress behavior is unchanged.

g.text: Annotation: Read top to bottom; left setup panel before right. Password is masked.
Bottom-left: actions y=38, height 32; panels end at y=158; count y=138; feedback y=94.
Both lists gain 44 px. Conditional feedback stays above actions; idle feedback remains blank.
